details.hoursNote: Reserve ahead, for current month or through end of following month. Linked booking policy: cancellation within72hours50%, within24hours100%; same-day reduction100%. Older main-page group policy differs, so consult the selected booking terms. Children require direct phone enquiry; online requests may be declined, and Ikyu lists no children.
